tasks.short: Perform authorised nursing duties and record actual results

steps.what: Verify the patient, actual nursing direction and permitted duty before medication, vital-sign or specimen work
inputs: actual nursing direction and current patient orders
verified patient identity
local role authorisation and competence requirements
outputs: verified patient-specific authorised duty and unresolved issues

steps.what: Perform the permitted nursing duty under actual nursing direction and obtain actual results
inputs: verified patient-specific authorised duty and unresolved issues
actual patient and authorised clinical equipment
outputs: actual performed duty, measurement or collected specimen
actual observations and any exception requiring nursing attention

steps.what: Capture actual performed-duty details and results in the patient chart, checking any device-populated measurement
inputs: actual performed duty, measurement or collected specimen
actual observations and any exception requiring nursing attention
patient-linked approved device output where available
outputs: complete actual duty and result record draft with missing values explicit

steps.what: Check and approve the completed patient chart entry against actual performance and results
inputs: complete actual duty and result record draft with missing values explicit
actual performed duty, measurement or collected specimen
outputs: approved final actual patient chart entry

steps.what: Save the approved actual duty and result entry in the patient chart
inputs: approved final actual patient chart entry

tasks.design: Configure existing approved measurement-device fields into the clinical chart {OPS_SYSTEM}, where the clinical equipment {OTHER} already supports a native patient-linked interface. The aide still verifies the patient, performs only authorised duties and captures actual performance and exceptions; no device feed implies that medication was given or a specimen was collected.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some actual vital-sign results may still require repeated chart field entry after measurement.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing approved device interface can populate actual measured values for review without changing care delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Role authorisation, patient cooperation, actual clinical performance and recognising exceptions remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: The aide notices distress and discrepancies between the displayed value and the actual patient encounter.

ambition.what: Reduce limited measurement-entry work while keeping care and actual documentation under nursing direction.

reach.task: Direct and supervise duties within actual role permissions
reach.learn: Which results may populate the chart and which require direct human entry

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for clinical-system approval, role permissions and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: some clinical measurement devices support patient-linked chart interfaces; actual duty performance and chart verification remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Provisional work-design shares, not measured nursing baselines or instructions to perform a clinical procedure.
The local employer and nursing staff determine which duties this aide may perform; the model does not expand that authority.
The proposed reduction applies only where actual measurements are produced in s2 by an approved linked device. Medication and specimen performance records remain directly captured in s3.
The retained half of s3 includes actual entry of non-device fields, exceptions and corrections. No planned value or scheduled duty is used as proof of completion.
Check existing native interfaces first. Without an approved interface, or if it already populates the chart, additional saving is zero.
The same-chart save takes approximately no time today and receives no saving. Any actual escalation follows the existing nursing process and is not an automated message claimed here.
unknowns: Which duties the local role may perform
Availability and current use of approved device interfaces
research_questions: How much actual measurement entry remains after existing native interfaces?

already_counted.description: Check final actual chart entry against performed duties and results

incremental.description: Check device-field mapping changes and handle interface exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual patient chart entry; changes return to s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only s3 changes: 12*(1-0.50)=6 gross hours. One upkeep hour gives central net 5%; two additional hours handling patient-link exceptions gives high 3%. Low zero without suitable native interface coverage or where it is already used. No physical-care or save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview patients on admission and record actual information

steps.what: Read the actual admission context and existing verified patient information
inputs: actual admission referral and permitted patient chart fields
verified patient identity
outputs: checked admission context and questions needing actual answers

steps.what: Interview the actual patient on admission and clarify their responses within the aide's assigned role
inputs: checked admission context and questions needing actual answers
patient's actual responses and observed communication needs
outputs: actual patient statements, observations and unanswered questions

steps.what: Record the actual admission information using permitted chart fields and verbatim dictation with correction
inputs: actual patient statements, observations and unanswered questions
existing verified administrative fields
outputs: complete actual admission note draft distinguishing patient statements from observations

steps.what: Approve the completed admission note after checking wording, attribution, negation and missing information
inputs: complete actual admission note draft distinguishing patient statements from observations
actual patient statements, observations and unanswered questions

steps.what: Save the approved actual admission note in the patient chart
inputs: approved final actual admission note

tasks.design: Configure a permitted admission view and native verbatim dictation in the clinical chart {OPS_SYSTEM}. The aide conducts the interview and dictates or enters the actual information, including corrections, then checks the complete note before the separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reading admission context and typing the aide's actual note may take effort around the patient conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native chart views and approved verbatim dictation can reduce field navigation and typing without generating clinical interpretations.
tasks.still_hard: Rapport, ambiguous responses and distinguishing a patient's account from an observed fact need human attention.
tasks.human_edge: The aide recognises when a question is distressing or an answer needs clarification from nursing staff.

ambition.what: Spend less time navigating and typing while preserving the actual admission conversation and faithful record.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for chart permissions, approved dictation and patient/staff privacy review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record views and verbatim speech dictation can reduce navigation and typing while a person checks the final note.

assumptions: Shares and saving rates are provisional scenarios, not observed admission-interview baselines.
Existing verified fields are reused only where still current; missing facts are asked in s2 and actually captured in s3.
s3 retains 17.5 hours per 100 for the aide's actual dictation or entry and correction; no free transcript or unnoticed recording is assumed.
Dictation is verbatim, with no generated summary or inferred diagnosis. If unavailable or unsuitable, manual entry remains.
Native settings first. The interview and same-system save receive no saving.
unknowns: Suitability and existing use of approved dictation
research_questions: Does dictation reduce net entry effort after faithful correction and final review?

already_counted.description: Check the complete note for actual meaning and attribution

incremental.description: Maintain permitted admission fields and handle dictation vocabulary or access issues

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual admission note; edits require renewed s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 7.5 context-view hours +7.5 note-entry hours =15. Two upkeep hours give central net 13%; four additional hours correcting dictation and ambiguous wording gives high 9%. Low zero if native features already cover this or dictation adds as much correction work as it removes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: nursing staff: determine permitted duties and resolve clinical concerns
clinical systems owner: approve chart views, device links and dictation
role.ambitious_version: A psychiatric aide with less chart navigation and typing, retaining direct patient support, actual observation and faithful recording within the authorised role.
